iPunk AI Radar

Privacy and usage analytics

Basic usage analytics is enabled by default to understand page visits, guide navigation and tool processing. Events are sent to PostHog’s US region in the same project as ipunk.cn, separated by site=ai.ipunk.cn. We use an anonymous browser identifier and session identifier stored for this origin. We do not send selected files, filenames, pasted responses, claim text, source URLs, URL queries or fragments. We do not enable session recording, automatic input/click capture, person profiles or marketing tracking. Source attribution retains only a referring hostname.

You can turn off analytics below. Existing refusals and browser Do Not Track / Global Privacy Control signals stop collection. Internal testing is excluded in each browser using a local setting; explicitly labeled delivery tests are excluded from the AI dashboard. Turning analytics off does not retract previously received events. Privacy requests: privacy@ipunk.cn.
